title: Knowlify vs Creative Milkshake for App Ads: Which to Pick
summary: Knowlify vs Creative Milkshake for app ads: AI video for Meta, or multilingual studio and creator ads across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. Compare scope and price.
body_markdown:
## What do Meta's rules mean for an app creative set?


Meta's[guide to Advantage+ app campaigns](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/2755245231412782) explains that targeting in those campaigns is limited to operating system, country and language, and that placements are not chosen by hand. We read that as the creative doing more of the audience work, so supply concepts for different users and situations rather than near-identical edits of one idea. Our[app promo video guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/app-promo-videos) covers the setup.


Meta's[mobile video ad guidance](https://www.facebook.com/business/news/want-to-better-video-ads-for-mobile-well-show-you-how) asks for a message in 15 seconds or less, the most captivating elements first, the brand shown early and an ad that works without sound. For placements, Meta's[Reels ads guidance](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/facebook-instagram-reels-ads) recommends vertical 9:16 video with audio and key messages inside the safe zone, and its[video ad guide](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads-guide/video) lists 4:5 for Facebook Feed. Ask every provider for both versions, with captions.


## What should an app brief include?


Give every provider the same written brief. Name the single job of each ad: an install, a trial start or one feature demo. Add the store listing claims you can substantiate, the screens or features to show, the languages and markets, and the person who approves claims. Admiral's page says it judges app winners on cost per trial and trial-to-paid, and games on cost per install and cohort ROAS, so decide your own deciding metric before you read any proposal.


Ask each provider how real app footage appears in the ad, and who supplies it. Ask Creative Milkshake for turnaround per language and per variant, since it does not publish one. Then compare accepted variants per week and per language, not the number of files delivered. Keep the brief to one page so proposals are easy to compare line by line.


## When does Creative Milkshake fit better, and when does Knowlify?


Creative Milkshake is the stronger candidate when one partner must cover several markets and platforms at once, and when you can accept an unpublished price. Ask for multi-language output and the number of variants in a written quote, since neither is published. Our[Creative Milkshake alternatives guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/creative-milkshake-alternatives) compares other options for the same brief.


Knowlify is the stronger candidate when the ads run on Facebook and Instagram, the work is AI video, and you want a steady supply of finished ads from one team. Keep TikTok, YouTube and app store work with another provider, and check our[mobile app marketing agencies guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-mobile-app-marketing-agencies) for options that cover them.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for AI video ads on Facebook and Instagram, with about 25 finished ads a week and optional Meta campaign management.
- Creative Milkshake fits app ads that need several languages and placements on Meta, TikTok and YouTube under one team.
- Admiral Media is the app-specific option that publishes batch prices, from €10,000 for 20 video ads.
- Knowlify does not run TikTok, LinkedIn, Google or YouTube ads and does not do app store optimization, so plan that work separately.


## FAQ


### Does Knowlify make app ads?


Knowlify makes finished AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, so an app can use them when the message and format fit. It does not do app store optimization or run Google or YouTube ads. Ask Knowlify directly whether your app's install goal fits its Meta scope before you commit.


### Does Creative Milkshake run TikTok and YouTube ads?


Its homepage says it offers media buying across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. Confirm the exact scope, minimums and reporting in a written proposal, because its pricing, minimums and turnaround are not published.


### Which option covers more languages?


Creative Milkshake lists ads in seven languages, produced from hubs in six European cities. This guide does not cover Knowlify's language range, so ask for it in writing before you plan a multi-market test.


### Should app ads use AI presenters or real people?


Use real people when the ad depends on a person's own experience with the app. Use AI presenters or animation for brand statements and product explanations; the FTC's testimonial guidance says there is no blanket ban on AI avatars, but an avatar is prohibited when the testimonial it delivers is fake or false ([FTC testimonial Q&A](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/consumer-reviews-testimonials-rule-questions-answers) ). Either way, make sure the ad's claims match your store listing and your evidence.


### Which provider publishes a price for app ad creative?


Of the providers compared here, Admiral Media does, with batches from €10,000 for 20 video ads. Creative Milkshake and Apptamin do not publish prices, and Knowlify starts at $5,000 a month. Ask each for a quote on the same number of accepted variants.
